instruction.name: ldx.b
instruction.description: ldx.b indexed load from rj + rk.

experiments.name: operand dependency chain
experiments.command: ./bench --method slope --unroll 1000 --unroll2 4000 --iters 1000 --warmup 10 --reps 20 --init 'addi.d $r20, $sp, -2048; li.d $r21, -64; and $r20, $r20, $r21; li.d $r21, 0; li.d $r22, 1; st.d $r22, $r20, 0' --asm 'ldx.b $r4, $r20, $r21; add.d $r20, $r20, $r4'
experiments.notes: rj -> rd chain: the base register is updated from the loaded value and the index stays 0; the add.d is subtracted.

latencies.notes: rj -> rd chain: the base register is updated from the loaded value and the index stays 0; the add.d is subtracted.

experiments.name: operand dependency chain
experiments.command: ./bench --method slope --unroll 1000 --unroll2 4000 --iters 1000 --warmup 10 --reps 20 --init 'addi.d $r20, $sp, -2048; li.d $r21, -64; and $r20, $r20, $r21; li.d $r22, 8; st.d $r22, $r20, 0; li.d $r4, 0' --asm 'ldx.b $r4, $r20, $r4; andi $r4, $r4, 7'
experiments.notes: rk -> rd chain: the index register is loop-carried; andi keeps it inside the buffer and its 1 cycle is subtracted.

latencies.notes: rk -> rd chain: the index register is loop-carried; andi keeps it inside the buffer and its 1 cycle is subtracted.

throughput.name: 8 independent lanes
throughput.init: addi.d $r20, $sp, -1024; addi.d $r4, $r0, 0; addi.d $r5, $r0, 8; addi.d $r6, $r0, 16; addi.d $r7, $r0, 24; addi.d $r8, $r0, 32; addi.d $r9, $r0, 40; addi.d $r10, $r0, 48; addi.d $r11, $r0, 56
throughput.command: ./bench --unroll 1000 --iters 1000 --warmup 10 --init 'addi.d $r20, $sp, -1024; addi.d $r4, $r0, 0; addi.d $r5, $r0, 8; addi.d $r6, $r0, 16; addi.d $r7, $r0, 24; addi.d $r8, $r0, 32; addi.d $r9, $r0, 40; addi.d $r10, $r0, 48; addi.d $r11, $r0, 56' --asm 'ldx.b $r12, $r20, $r4; ldx.b $r13, $r20, $r5; ldx.b $r14, $r20, $r6; ldx.b $r15, $r20, $r7; ldx.b $r16, $r20, $r8; ldx.b $r17, $r20, $r9; ldx.b $r18, $r20, $r10; ldx.b $r19, $r20, $r11'
throughput.notes: 8 independent memory operations take 4.00 cycles. Buffer is at $sp-1024.

notes: L1D-hit indexed load. The base path is 4 cycles and the index path is 5 cycles: combining base and index costs one extra cycle. Measured with the slope method on 2026-11-17.
